description: Find the RSS, Atom and JSON feeds a website publishes (validated by downloading and parsing each one), with feed title, type, last post date, post count and the newest posts. Use when you need a feed URL for a site or want to know if a site has a feed. Up to 5 sites per call.

max_items_per_feed.description: Latest posts to include per feed (0-10)

sites.description: Websites, domains, section URLs (example.com/blog), Reddit/Medium/YouTube-channel/GitHub-repo URLs, or a feed URL. Up to 5.

name: find_feeds
title: Find RSS/Atom/JSON feeds of websites
